subject: [RFC PATCH 57/57] MAINTAINERS: add an entry for collapse

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Suggested that the maintainers and reviewers of THP should also be listed for the new collapse section, as it is a separation of existing logic.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with Lorenzo's suggestion, but Kiryl Shutsemau declined to volunteer maintainers.

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes to separate the THP (Transparent Huge Pages) collapse logic into its own body of code, mm/collapse.c, and add a new section for it in the MAINTAINERS file. The patch moves existing code related to THP collapse out of khugepaged.c and updates selftests to match the new location.
